name: Gulf / US–Iran war
summary: US struck Iranian launchers after Iran hit a US base in Bahrain; Iran says tankers hit its mines on 19–20 Nov
state: US forces struck Iranian missile launchers at Bandar Lengeh and Sirik after Iran attacked a US base in Bahrain and fired at tankers, and a third US carrier arrived in the region (Euronews, 16 Nov). Iran's Revolutionary Guard said on 20 Nov that two supertankers caught fire after hitting mines in Hormuz, claims not independently verified (AP via Daily Waadaa). No ceasefire was found. Active strikes between states and attacks on shipping keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Iran and the Gulf states. The conflict keeps oil, gas and shipping costs elevated.
rubric_hit: Active strikes between states and attacks on shipping = Alert

sources.title: Euronews — US and Iran slide closer to fresh all-out war
Daily Waadaa (AP) — Israel strikes Hezbollah site; IRGC claims tankers hit mines

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
